Thanks — I dug into the Coupa tenant logs for VeldtCo. Two things stood out:

1) Coupa's bank validation microservice returned a 422 for the routing/account pair; the error text indicates "account name mismatch vs tax registry". That often happens when the Beneficiary name on the bank file doesn't match the W-9's legal name.

2) There is also a single-session cookie redirect that happens when users submit the bank form from a mobile browser — looks like AP submitted from a mobile device. The session cookie expires and Coupa sends them back to SSO.

Action items from supplier ops:
- Asha: please confirm masked account (****2345) and whether the bank list name is "VeldtCo, LLC" or "VeldtCo Solutions".
